notes: Part g (narrative, no figure): An assurance-type warranty is not a separate performance obligation because it only guarantees the product performs as promised rather than transferring an additional distinct service, so no part of the transaction price is deferred; instead the future repair cost is a probable and reasonably estimable obligation arising from the past sale, so it is accrued as a loss contingency (Warranty Expense / Warranty Liability) in the period of sale under the matching principle. Part f: the Year 3 beginning liability plus the Year 3 accrual covers the 55,000 paid, so the whole payment is charged to the liability with no direct expense.
